// Missing ConsistencyLevel field compared to QueryReqV2/SearchReqV2 which have:
// ConsistencyLevel string `json:"consistencyLevel"`
verdicts.rationale: Contract (milvus_type_collections_create_003) explicitly requires consistencyLevel in ['Strong', 'Session', 'Bounded', 'Eventually']. Raw request POST /collections/create with consistencyLevel='Invalid' returns HTTP 200 (success). Source code reveals CollectionReq struct lacks ConsistencyLevel field (unlike QueryReqV2/SearchReqV2), so JSON binding silently ignores invalid values. Handler validation at handler_v2.go:2042-2057 only checks httpReq.Params['consistencyLevel'], not the direct field. This is a Type1_IllegalSuccess: API accepts invalid enum value and silently defaults to 'Bounded' instead of rejecting with 400 error.

clean_repro.observed: HTTP 200 success, describe shows consistencyLevel='Bounded' (silent default)
